item.name: Force Boots

effects.title: Force
effects.text:
Pushes the target 750 units in the direction they are facing. Dispels if cast on an ally.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

effects.title: Speed Unlock
effects.text:
Completely removes the speed limit for the wearer 
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
item.lore: Elusive marvels never successfully studied for proper classification in the archives.
